## L4 · Digest + Speed-to-Lead board
**Board:** open `/webhook/halden-board` in a browser (sign-in first). Last 7 days from HubSpot: each lead as a dot on a **sun arc** by the hour it arrived, median seconds from form submit to first email, tiers, reply rate, and every lead with its status and follow-ups. Light/dark toggle; on a phone the table becomes cards with a **Call** button. Refreshes every minute.
**Digest:** every day at **8 AM PKT**, the same numbers for the last 24 hours plus the hot-lead list, emailed to the team.

One path for both: the trigger decides the mode.

## Numbers come from HubSpot only
4 searches: recent leads (newest 100) + totals for awaiting / replied / closed.
All lead text is HTML-escaped before it reaches the page or email.
The board is read-only and sits behind the sign-in page (**Auth** node).

## Sign-in
Both board doors (GET page, POST form) go through **Auth**.
Signed in → the board. Otherwise → the sign-in page (light/dark, same brand).

Set `BOARD_PASSWORD` in **Auth** (10+ characters). Sessions: 8 h, HttpOnly cookie. 5 wrong passwords → 15-minute lock. The 8 AM digest never needs a login.
